title: Zoning text change for 132 Melrose Street, Brooklyn
summary: This application would amend the city's zoning map rules to require affordable housing at 132-136 Melrose Street in Bushwick, Brooklyn, in conjunction with a related rezoning. The combined actions would allow a new six-story mixed-use building with 18 apartments, including five permanently income-restricted units, and 6,000 square feet of ground-floor commercial space. The City Council held a public hearing on the proposal on August 12, 2026.
